units.source_text: 以上采录的《奉教人之死》一篇，据说是根据下卷第二篇，疑为长崎西教堂遗事的实录。

en.t: The piece titled “The Death of a Christian” recorded above is said to be based on the second piece in the second volume, and is thought to be a factual account of an old incident at the western church in Nagasaki.

units.source_text: 但是所记录的火灾，经查《长崎港草》等书，并未找到事实依据，

en.t: However, after checking books such as Nagasaki Port Miscellany, no factual basis was found for the fire described there,

units.source_text: 事情发生年代久远，因此也无从查证了。

en.t: and since the events happened so long ago, there is now no way to verify them.
